title: RimWorld complete family map: provenance, selected routes and semantic gaps
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: overlapping inventories, rough routing and bounded runtime-source closure qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1: Complete actual map review covers every field of all363systems:55runtime rows,254definition families,23namespaces,16code-prefix families and15new runtime routes. All854retained prior rows, exact three inventory paths/line locators/columns, raw-count maps,31routing blocks, dictionary values,25prior-row templates and count shapes were read. The [lossless reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/rimworld-family-lossless-view-b600.json) and [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/rimworld-family-view-receipt-b600.json) reconstruct the original22861-line JSON exactly. Original bytes/schema stay unchanged. Snapshot1.7.4979rev109 remains historical; this review does not reread raw C#/XML/native/private artifacts or refresh installation/upstream identity.

F2: Inventory-kind/name deduplication retains854prior provenance rows, not854independent systems.252definition families have counts in all three inventories; MaterialDef and ShaderDef have only first/deep count rows. The254raw tags, older252tag signal,9213exported C#files, namespace sizes, method-prefix counts, raw XML nodes and effective post-load definitions are different evidence units. Sample file paths may contain many different tags and include anonymous/abstract/inherited nodes; no raw count becomes reachable content, complete behavior or a product backlog. Exact BackStoryDef/BackstoryDef, JobDef/jobDef, BossDef/BossgroupDef and other source spellings remain separate until an actual loader/source interpretation establishes their relationship.

F3: Rough inferred routing is not an exact semantic owner: generated social exchange can route to body, MapGeneratorDef/GeneratedLocationDef to body, belief/production/event pacing and broad engine rows to infrastructure, while specific later leaves name more appropriate social/world/institution/production consumers. Preserve the original route and qualify its meaning rather than forcing a new body or engine feature. Forty-nine owner_gap flags cover donor implementation details or the specific S13power-network leaf; generic engine/UI/technology/production homes exist. Neither a flag nor false means verified absence or completed implementation. Whole namespaces and prefix families remain indexed-only even when a selected source type appears in S01–S15.

F4: S01 usable capacities differs from body/render taxonomy; S02 treatment quality, disease severity, immunity and recovery differ; S03 ingestion, tolerance, dependency and policy differ. Their selected consumers do not close all damage/hit/armor/surgery/medicine or every drug/body exception. S04 directed opinion, direct relationships/family references and remembered deeds differ; S05 pressure, selected break and recovery differ. S06 retained learning, prerequisites and commanded useful work needs actual trainer/learner means and does not close every job/AI or bonded species. Preserve useful attributable care, earned companion work and consequential relationship ideas without importing donor balance, arbitrary caps or a universal social meter.

F5: S07 title/favor/institution permit and delivery conditions are distinct from S08 bodily psylink, learned ability, current focus, entropy and target/cast. Selected services/powers do not close all permits, inheritance, effects or unsupported-target settlement. S09 trade quote/commit and generated periodic settlement stock does not establish funded offscreen production or autonomous economy. S10 caravan needs, travel and conditional foraging do not establish every away-clock/path/support case. S11 goodwill situations and relation hysteresis are not one instantaneous reputation scalar or full diplomacy. S12 plant growth/harvest/ecological admission does not close every generator, biome, terrain, worker, yield or future offscreen restoration consumer.

F6: S13 output, stored reserve, topology and actual service are separate. A dedicated power-network topology/automatic shedding contract was not located in the checked owners; broad technology/production homes already exist and no new engine is mandated. S14 sequence failure preserves earlier mutations rather than rollback; raw XML counts do not resolve active patches/mod conflicts, inherited effective definitions or historical migration compatibility. S15 temporary Slate dictionary copy retains object references, so it is not isolated world-state sandboxing. Selected sequence/random/delay/end generation joins saved quest-part lifecycle without closing every script/reward/actor/condition or asynchronous settlement. Framework traces do not prove exactly-once gameplay effects.

F7: Keep DS-P1–DS-P8's useful task affected by body condition, paid gradual care, paired companion training, caused relationship, conditional institutional service, distinct power reserves/load, fully quoted trade and finite place-supported crop/travel output as research proposals in existing owners. The report's old Village P01/one-realm milestone statement is historical and superseded by current scope. Desktop1366x768 remains the recorded proposal target, not browser evidence. Prior1.6receipts and later1.7selected reads retain their own input identities and remaining gates. No source/game/content-loader/native UI execution, acquisition, private-state access, runtime/build/browser/save test, gameplay edit, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: All363records/854prior rows read through exact reversible common-value/template view in seven bounded outputs; finite REPORT fully read; underlying raw bodies not newly read.
reviews.reopen: Any selected consumer needs actual current source and scoped gameplay proof; preserve remaining named-only families and S01–S15 partial bounds.
